title: Exchange a finite flat map and a completely decomposed etale family
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], meaning it has a finite affine cover by Noetherian rings. Let $\ell$ be prime, and let $f:Y\to X$ be finite locally free of constant positive rank $d$ prime to $\ell$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Let $(v_i:V_i\to Y)_i$ be a finite family of separated etale morphisms of finite type [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] that is completely decomposed: every $y\in Y$ has a point of some $V_i$ above it inducing an isomorphism of residue fields [def-weil-residue-field]. There exist a finite completely decomposed family of separated etale morphisms $u_j:U_j\to X$ of finite type, finite locally free surjections $c_j:Z_j\to U_j$ of constant positive ranks $d_j$ prime to $\ell$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism], indices $i(j)$, and $X$-morphisms $g_j:Z_j\to V_{i(j)}$ satisfying $f v_{i(j)}g_j=u_jc_j$. Neither $U_j$ nor $Z_j$ is asserted integral or reduced.

source.place: Expose II, proof of Theorem 3.2.3, exchange assertion, printed pp. 30--31 (the printed W_j in Z_j -> W_j denotes U_j); finite affine-open refinement by Corollary 2.2.4, printed p. 27.
